items.context: This year's theme centres on safe charging of lithium-ion batteries in phones, e-bikes and scooters. Free parking and a shuttle from Bronte GO are offered, and no registration is needed. Test Your Smoke Alarm Day follows on September 28.
items.headline: Oakville Fire kicks off Fire Prevention Week today with lithium-ion battery focus

Separately, Carney announced changes to his parliamentary secretary team the same day.

items.context: The 10-year Treasury yield climbed to 5.18%, its highest since the global financial crisis, on inflation worries. items.context: Urban inflation eased to 14.5% in August from 14.9% in July, while core inflation edged up to 14.9%. Growth slowed to 4.7% in the second quarter from 5.0%. The bank has been on hold since April, when regional conflict halted an easing cycle; one analyst at HC Securities had called for a hike, citing fuel subsidy cuts and rent adjustments ahead. The CBE expects inflation to start falling gradually from early 2027 toward its 7% (plus or minus 2) target.
